title: Healthcare Leadership Council Spotlights Labcorp’s AI Innovation
summary: A recent Healthcare Leadership Council blog explored how artificial intelligence is advancing healthcare innovation by supporting clinical decision-making, improving efficiency and enabling more personalized patient care.
body_markdown:
A recent[Healthcare Leadership Council](https://www.hlc.org/news/from-discovery-to-delivery-how-ai-is-advancing-healthcare-innovation-and-patient-care/) blog explored how artificial intelligence is advancing healthcare innovation by supporting clinical decision-making, improving efficiency and enabling more personalized patient care.


Among the solutions featured was Labcorp’s AI-supported Test Finder, which helps clinicians quickly identify appropriate laboratory tests. Brian Caveney, M.D., Labcorp’s chief medical and scientific officer, noted that clinicians face increasing demands on their time, and Test Finder is designed to simplify test selection and navigation so providers can focus on patient care.


Read the[full blog post](https://www.hlc.org/news/from-discovery-to-delivery-how-ai-is-advancing-healthcare-innovation-and-patient-care/) on the Healthcare Leadership Council’s website to learn how organizations across healthcare are using AI to enhance care delivery and improve operational efficiency.
